holdout.reason: First resumed untouched period after the calendar-confounded 2025Q4 source gap; source currently ends in February 2026.

unchanged_policy.selection: prior-only q50 absolute normalized Ridge prediction
unchanged_policy.training: all chronology-valid rows strictly before holdout, with H12 purge

fixed_consumers.same_selected_always_long: Trade +1 on every unchanged Ridge-selected row.
fixed_consumers.flat_on_negative: Trade +1 only when unchanged Ridge sign is positive; remain flat when unchanged Ridge sign is negative.
fixed_consumers.full_ridge: Trade +1 on positive unchanged Ridge signs and -1 on negative unchanged Ridge signs.

question: Does the sparse negative Ridge sign add genuine episodic tail-defense value beyond simply avoiding those longs?
required_outputs: full_ridge minus flat_on_negative paired weekly deltas
early_holdout_classification_rule: SUPPORT only if at both 1pt and 2pt, with at least four paired valid weeks, full Ridge has higher cumulative points, less-negative max drawdown, and a better worst week than flat-on-negative. Otherwise NOT_CONFIRMED; if breadth is below four weeks, INSUFFICIENT_BREADTH. This short holdout can support or fail to confirm tail-defense, but cannot establish broad short alpha or promotion authority.
forbidden_rescue: calling a short holdout broad directional alpha
